ai.say: MORE! THE CROWD WANTS MORE!

ai.name: Lure-Light
ai.say: The lure flickers... you forget the words.
Catch me if you can, groundlings!
Gravelmaw burrows into the rock and hardens.
"Is that really you? Show me."

ai.name: Forget
ai.say: "What were you called again?"
"Finders keepers!"
"All hands! ALL HANDS!"

ai.name: Quota Lash
ai.say: "Back to work."
The bear swallows a lantern and glows.

ai.name: Covet
ai.say: "That's MINE. Everything she had should have been MINE."

phases.say: "Why did they always look at HER?" The flames turn sickly green.

ai.say: "Stay. Everyone stays. No one else leaves me."

phases.say: "I kept the whole sea so I would never have to let go."

ai.name: Gilded Cage
ai.say: "Safer inside. Everyone is safer inside."

phases.say: Corvane's own cage cracks open. For a moment he looks... relieved.

ai.name: Gild
ai.say: "Hold still. Gold doesn't flinch."

phases.say: Gold drips from the cracks in the king. Underneath is ordinary stone.

ai.say: "Not yet. I'm not finished. I'm never finished." Iris becomes something else.
Nobody isn't here anymore. Your weapons pass through the place he was.

ai.name: Behold
ai.say: "I have seen you before you were born."

phases.say: A thousand eyes open across the sky.

ai.say: Nihil folds away from the world.

phases.say: The stars behind Nihil go out, one by one.
"Before you, nothing. After you, nothing. Why fight?"

ai.say: "My children! My hungry children!"
Water pours over the guardian's stone shell.
"Shiny! Mine!"
The wraith's lantern brightens.
"GUARDS! Somebody stab the hero!"

ai.name: Royal Pilfer
ai.say: "Everything shiny belongs to the KING."
King Goblin gulps down a jar of something green.

phases.say: "You broke my curses. ALL SIX. Do you know how long those took?!" The crown blazes.
"No, no, no... a goblin king doesn't lose to some... some SLAYER!"

ai.say: A ring of light closes over the Blessed's wounds.
Quickfang darts in circles, faster and faster.
The Ironshell blinks, very slowly. It seems to have forgotten what it was doing.

ai.name: Gobble
ai.say: "MINE," says the chest.
The Mimic snaps its lid shut and hunkers down.
The Woolgorger chews something woolly and looks very pleased.
The Woolgorger yawns enormously... and falls asleep.

main_fire.title: The Green Flame
main_fire.desc: Ignatia's brother Vulkar has become a monster of green fire in the Envy Forge, north of the Ashen Wilds.

comp_fire.title: Chains of the Pit
comp_fire.desc: Slagjaw, the ogre who owned Kael, still guards Kael's old blade deep in Smolder Hollow.

side_fire.title: The Bellows Thief
side_fire.desc: A scavenger called Scrapjack stole the Great Bellows. He was last seen in the Ashen Wilds.

key_fire.title: The Widow's Hammer
key_fire.desc: Hesta's late husband Brannoc lost his hammer in Smolder Hollow. She wants it back.

main_water.title: The Tide That Won't Go Out
main_water.desc: Maren, the Mother of Tides, grieves at the bottom of the Sunken Cradle, east of the Weeping Shoals.

comp_water.title: The Dark Lighthouse
comp_water.desc: The lighthouse lens was swallowed by Gloomfin, a huge angler fish in the Drowned Grotto.

side_water.title: Nets of the Drowned
side_water.desc: The ghost of Captain Corrow haunts the Weeping Shoals and tangles every net.

key_water.title: Three Notes
key_water.desc: Old Tobiah's daughter left a music box in the Drowned Grotto before the tide took her.

main_wind.title: The Keeper of Cages
main_wind.desc: Corvane has caged the winds of Skyreach in the Gilded Aviary, beyond the Whistling Heights.

comp_wind.title: Stolen Wings
comp_wind.desc: Captain Rook and his sky pirates stole Pip's glider-wings. Rook nests in the Hollow Winds Cave.

side_wind.title: The Silent Bells
side_wind.desc: Sylvane the Bell-Thief stole Kitefall's wind-bells. She hides in the Whistling Heights.

key_wind.title: Grandpa's First Kite
key_wind.desc: Lark's grandfather lost his first kite in the Hollow Winds Cave.

main_stone.title: The Gilded King
main_stone.desc: King Ostrum sold the mountain's heart for gold and turned to gilded stone. He rules from the Gilded Throne.

comp_stone.title: The Buried Crew
comp_stone.desc: Durga's mining crew is trapped below the Glimmering Seam by Gravelmaw, a beast of the deep rock.

side_stone.title: Rust in the Veins
side_stone.desc: The Iron Overseer runs a forced dig in Rustvein Canyon. Breck wants him gone.

key_stone.title: Garrick's Lucky Pick
key_stone.desc: Old Garrick dropped his lucky pick in the Glimmering Seam.

main_spirit.title: The Unfinished
main_spirit.desc: Iris, a saint who could never finish becoming herself, reshapes everyone in the Ascent of the Unfinished.

comp_spirit.title: The Hollow Mirror
comp_spirit.desc: In the Mirror Caves, a mirror shows Sol a self that isn't his. He has to face it.

side_spirit.title: The Pilgrim's Lantern
side_spirit.desc: A great bear eats the lanterns pilgrims carry through the Fields of Becoming.

omni_spirit.title: The Witness
omni_spirit.desc: Behind a door in the Ascent waits Aeon, the Witness. It needs the Keys of Memory and Breath, and four of you.

main_void.title: Nobody Home
main_void.desc: A man named Aldous stepped out of himself to escape his pain. What's left, Nobody, haunts the Unmoored Keep.

comp_void.title: The Name-Eater
comp_void.desc: Vesper's true name was eaten by the Name-Eater in the Echo Pits.

side_void.title: Echo of a Song
side_void.desc: The Mute Paladin stole every song in Lastlight. He walks The Drift.

omni_void.title: The Throne of Nothing
omni_void.desc: Behind a door in the Unmoored Keep sits Nihil, the Unmaker. It needs the Keys of Ash and Bedrock, and four of you.

side2_fire.title: The Smith's Vault
side2_fire.desc: Something gnaws beneath Widow Hesta's house. Brannoc's old vault has been taken by a king of ember rats.

side2_water.title: Behind the Water
side2_water.desc: A door hides behind the Weeping Falls. A stone guardian has kept it for a century.

side2_wind.title: The Belfry Thief
side2_wind.desc: A harpy has made the old bell tower her nest and steals every kite that flies past.

side2_stone.title: Something Eats the Props
side2_stone.desc: Mine props keep vanishing. Something under the old house is eating iron, and the tunnel will collapse.

side2_spirit.title: The Quiet Crypt
side2_spirit.desc: Beneath the chapter house is a crypt nobody visits. Lately, a light walks there at night.

side2_void.title: The Room That Isn't
side2_void.desc: There's a door upstairs in an empty house that opens onto a room that shouldn't exist.

main_king.title: Origin of the Goblin Slayer
main_king.desc: King Goblin cursed all six Hearths. Free them, then enter his Warren from the Nexus.

appear: The white figures don't speak. Their lenses turn toward you, one after another.
A smell of salt and hot brass. Something hums under the white cloth.
"The Work is unfinished. You are part of the unfinished."
They flicker, here and then a step to the left, as if the world can't decide where they stand.
"We were the base matter once. Be still. It hurts less."
first: Three figures in white step out of nothing. Where they stand, the grass bleaches pale.
One of them lifts a weapon of brass and glass. It hums like a held breath.
salvage: Among the white cloth there's a weapon still humming. It's warm, and it fits your hand too well.
The white cloth is empty. Only a brass weapon remains, its glass still lit from inside.
Their weapon doesn't break when they do. It waits, as if it had been waiting for you.

story: TILLY: "Mister! Have you seen a ferret? White, with one brown ear? His name's Biscuit."
BRAM: "Something took him. It came down the hill so fast the grass didn't even bend. Just a blur and a squeal."
TILLY: "I hit it with my slingshot. Just once. It screamed like I'd cut it in half and dropped Biscuit's collar."
BRAM: "It's living in the old fox den. There's a treasure pile in there too, we saw it glinting. Shiny stuff, real shiny."
biscuit.ask: Help Bram and Tilly get Biscuit back? (They'll split the treasure with you.)
accept: BRAM: "Really?! It's out here somewhere. Look for where the grass is all flattened."
TILLY: "You don't have to hit it hard. Just hit it."
pre: A white weasel the size of a wolf, eyes like wet glass. A ferret's collar hangs from its teeth.
It's gone before you can blink. Then it's behind you.
post: Quickfang squeals and folds up like a wet rag. A white ferret scrambles out of the den, very annoyed.
thanks: TILLY: "BISCUIT!" The ferret climbs up her sleeve and sulks.
BRAM: "The treasure's all yours, mister. Well, half. Okay, MOST. Biscuit's all we wanted."

story: MERRIN: "Fifty years, our music box played us to sleep. Odo carved it for me the week we married."
ODO: "A great shelled beast swallowed it whole. Then our cart. Then most of the fence."
MERRIN: "It's the slowest creature alive. We walked away from it eating breakfast, and it still hadn't reached us by lunch."
ODO: "I hit it with my hammer. The hammer broke. But when Merrin sang the old spell-songs at it, it groaned and its shell went soft."
MERRIN: "It sleeps on a hoard. Old soldiers' gear, coins, a whole lifetime of shiny things it ate."
music_box.ask: Help Odo and Merrin get their music box back? (They'll split the hoard with you.)
accept: MERRIN: "Sing to it, dear. Magic, I mean. Swords just annoy it."
decline: MERRIN: "Of course. We'll wait. We've gotten good at waiting."
pre: A tortoise as big as a house, shell plated with swallowed iron. Somewhere inside it, faintly, a music box is playing.
post: The Ironshell sighs, a long tired sound, and coughs up a fence post, a cart wheel... and a small carved box.
thanks: MERRIN: "Oh, listen, Odo. It still plays."
ODO: "Take the rest. We've got all we need now."

story: JUNIE: "We were going to be married at the spring festival. Hal saved two years for the ring."
HAL: "A glittering serpent took it right off the table. It bit straight through my shield like it was bread."
JUNIE: "But Hal threw a rock at it and its whole tail chipped off. It's made of glass, I swear. Gorgeous and awful."
HAL: "It keeps a nest of stolen jewelry. If you help, we'll share it. I just want the ring."
ring.ask: Help Hal and Junie get their ring back? (They'll share the nest's treasure.)
accept: HAL: "Don't let it bite you. It will hurt. A lot."
JUNIE: "Hit it first, and hit it hard."
decline: HAL: "Yeah. I wouldn't fight it either."
pre: A serpent of clear glass, light breaking into colors along its coils. A gold ring glints deep in its belly.
post: The Glass Wyrm cracks from tail to fang and falls apart like a dropped chandelier. A gold ring rolls to your boots.
thanks: JUNIE: "Hal. Hal, it's not even scratched."
HAL: "The festival's back on. Take your share, you've earned the whole nest."

story: NIM: "My doll's name is Lady Button. She has one eye and a very good hat."
PELL: "She was in a treasure chest we found. Except the chest had teeth. And it ate her."
NIM: "We camped by it all night, crying. When the campfire popped and a spark hit it, it SCREAMED and ran off on little legs."
PELL: "It's full of treasure. Real treasure. And Lady Button. Mostly Lady Button."
doll.ask: Help Nim and Pell rescue Lady Button? (They'll share whatever's inside the chest.)
accept: PELL: "It's tough. Really, really tough. Our sticks just went boing."
NIM: "But it hates fire. Remember the fire."
pre: A treasure chest on spider legs, gilded and grinning. A small one-eyed doll peers out from between its teeth.
post: The Gilded Mimic bursts open in a shower of coins and splinters. Lady Button lands hat-first in the grass.
thanks: PELL: "You can have the treasure. All of it. We just wanted her back."

story: WIL: "My grandpa's lucky hat. He's worn it through three wars and a bad marriage."
GORRIN: "A big silver moth came down out of the moon and took it. Took it right off my head!"
WIL: "I'm a fair hand at spells. Every one I threw bounced straight back and singed my own eyebrows off."
GORRIN: "So I whacked it with a frying pan, and it fell right out of the air. Moths. Soft as butter, under all that shine."
WIL: "It's got a nest full of shiny things. Bring the hat home and you can have the rest."
hat.ask: Help Gorrin and Wil get the lucky hat back? (They'll give you the rest of the nest.)
accept: GORRIN: "Leave the magic at home. Bring a pan."
WIL: "Or a sword. A sword's basically a sharp pan."
decline: GORRIN: "Hmph. Luck's gone anyway, I suppose."
pre: A moth with mirror-bright wings wide as a barn door. A battered old hat is stuck to one of its legs.
post: The Mirror Moth's wings crack like ice on a pond. The hat drifts down and lands perfectly on Gorrin's head.
thanks: WIL: "Take the rest, please. And thank you for saving my eyebrows. What's left of them."

story: CORIN: "Forty sheep we had. Now we've got eleven, a dog, and nightmares."
DALE: "Something huge and woolly eats them whole. We should run, but it doesn't even chase. It just eats, and then it naps."
CORIN: "Naps right in the middle of a fight. I watched it fall asleep with a ewe halfway in its mouth."
DALE: "It gets fatter and meaner with every one. But it takes its sweet time between bites."
CORIN: "There's a lot of coin and gear from the shepherds who tried before us. Help us, and it's yours to share."
flock.ask: Help Corin and Dale stop the beast eating their flock? (They'll share what the other shepherds left.)
accept: DALE: "Hit it while it sleeps. That's what I'd do, if I were brave."
CORIN: "You'll want to finish it fast. It heals while it eats."
decline: CORIN: "Eleven sheep. Ten by tomorrow, probably."
pre: A mountain of dirty wool with a mouth. Bells from a dozen lost sheep clank around its neck.
post: The Woolgorger sags over with a final enormous snore and doesn't get up. Somewhere underneath, a sheep bleats.
thanks: DALE: "We're down to eleven sheep, but we've got eleven sheep!"
CORIN: "Take the shepherds' gear. They'd want it used."

story: IVY: "Our little brother made a lantern for the night market. It was the brightest one there."
AMA: "A shadow took it. A real shadow, standing up on its own, with yellow eyes. It moves faster than you can turn your head."
IVY: "It hits so hard. But when Ama lit a prayer candle, it flinched like the light was burning it."
AMA: "It hoards every light it steals. Lanterns, lamps, gold, glass. Help us, and you can share whatever's in its dark."
lantern.ask: Help Ama and Ivy get their brother's lantern back? (They'll share the shadow's hoard.)
accept: AMA: "Bring light. Holy light, if you have it."
IVY: "And don't let it hit you first."
decline: IVY: "He made it out of paper and a jam jar. He'll make another. ...He'll cry first."
pre: A shadow stands up out of the ground, taller than any man. In its claws, a little paper lantern still glows.
post: The Lantern Thief comes apart like smoke in sunlight. A paper lantern bobs gently to the ground, still lit.
thanks: IVY: "It's still lit. It's still LIT!"
AMA: "Take the rest of the hoard. We only came for this one light."
